No browser, model provider or quote-accuracy claim.

receipt.scope: Actual public installCommunityItems and activateCommunityItem calls using official CLI and authenticated local HTTP. Exact bundled archives and the declared pinned native dependency policy use an isolated package store; the installed lockfile is retained by SHA. Shared package add/remove are deduplicated. A controlled edit in an isolated fixture blocks restoration after package removal; resolving that edit and retrying the public entry restores both original companion directories byte-for-byte without repeating package removal. No browser or feature coverage is claimed beyond earlier frozen runtime receipts.
